title: Danger Zone
summary: Keeps destructive settings visible but locked until deliberately unlocked, so a stray click doesn't delete or transfer something.
description: Destructive actions stay listed with their consequences but locked until the user deliberately unlocks the section, which relocks after one action, an idle timeout (60 s default), Escape, a hidden tab or focus leaving it.
catches: Stray clicks on destructive actions while the section is locked
An unlocked section left open (idle timeout, tab hidden, focus leaving)
Chained destructive actions, by relocking after each one
limits: Unlocking is a deliberate click, not authentication; pair it with re-auth or typed confirmation for serious actions
It does not perform or confirm the action itself
a11y: Section labelled by its title; the unlock toggle uses aria-pressed
Locked actions use aria-disabled so they stay focusable and are described by their consequence
Escape relocks; lock state changes are aria-live="polite"
server: Authorise every destructive action on the server and require re-authentication where it matters; the lock is a UI guard.
mistakes: delete button in settings clicked by mistake
